text: Implement a JavaScript function that removes duplicate array items while preserving order.
expected_response: Use a Set to track seen values and filter the array, preserving insertion order while removing duplicates in O(n) time.

text: Debug JavaScript TypeError when calling map on undefined data.
expected_response: Guard against undefined by using optional chaining or a fallback empty array before calling .map, preventing the TypeError at its source.

text: Optimize JavaScript render performance by memoizing expensive derived state.
expected_response: Wrap the expensive computation in a memoization function that caches results keyed by input, recomputing only when the input changes.

text: Implement binary search in JavaScript for a sorted numeric array.
expected_response: Use two pointers converging toward the middle to find the target in O(log n) time, returning the index or -1 if not found.

text: Refactor Node.js handler to use async await with explicit error propagation.
expected_response: Replace promise chains with async/await and wrap the body in try/catch so errors propagate to the caller or error-handling middleware.

text: Write Jest tests for JavaScript date parsing utility with timezone cases.
expected_response: Test the parser against ISO strings with explicit UTC and offset timezones to verify it normalizes correctly.

text: Implement a JavaScript debounce helper for UI search inputs.
expected_response: Return a wrapper that delays invoking the function until after a specified wait period has elapsed since the last call, using clearTimeout/setTimeout.

text: Debug promise chain where rejection is swallowed before catch.
expected_response: Ensure every .then callback returns the inner promise so rejections propagate down the chain to the terminal .catch handler.

text: Optimize JavaScript loop processing large JSON arrays without blocking UI.
expected_response: Break the work into chunks processed across animation frames so the main thread yields between batches, keeping the UI responsive.

text: Implement Express middleware for request id propagation.
expected_response: Attach a unique request ID from the incoming header or generate one with crypto.randomUUID, then set it on the response header for tracing.

text: Refactor JavaScript module exports to modern ES module syntax.
expected_response: Replace module.exports and require() calls with named export declarations and import statements for ES module compatibility.

text: Write tests for tokenizer behavior in JavaScript including punctuation and unicode.
expected_response: Cover plain words, punctuation splitting, and unicode characters to verify the tokenizer handles all expected input classes.

text: Implement a JavaScript LRU cache class with O(1) get and put operations.
expected_response: Use a Map whose insertion order tracks recency; on access move the entry to the end, and on overflow delete the oldest (first) key.

text: Debug JavaScript undefined property access in nested API response object.
expected_response: Use optional chaining to safely traverse the nested response, returning undefined instead of throwing when an intermediate property is missing.

text: Optimize JavaScript DOM update loop to avoid layout thrashing.
expected_response: Batch all DOM reads before writes so the browser does not interleave layout recalculations between each update, eliminating forced synchronous layouts.

text: Refactor JavaScript reducer logic into pure functional helper functions.
expected_response: Extract each case branch into a standalone pure function that takes state and payload and returns a new state object, keeping the reducer a simple dispatch table.

text: Write Jest tests for retry helper behavior with exponential backoff.
expected_response: Use fake timers to fast-forward through the backoff delays and verify the function retries the correct number of times before succeeding or exhausting attempts.

text: Implement JavaScript interval merge for sorted numeric ranges.
expected_response: Sort intervals by start, then iterate and merge overlapping ones by extending the current interval's end when overlap is detected.

text: Debug JavaScript promise chain where errors are swallowed before catch.
expected_response: The bug is a missing return statement inside a .then callback; without it the inner promise is detached and its rejection never reaches the outer .catch.

text: Optimize JavaScript JSON processing by reducing object allocations.
expected_response: Reuse a single output object and mutate its fields during iteration rather than creating a new object per item, reducing GC pressure.

text: Refactor JavaScript module boundaries to separate transport and business logic.
expected_response: Move the pure business logic into its own module and have the HTTP handler import and call it, so the logic is testable without a running server.

text: Write Jest unit tests for pagination helper edge cases.
expected_response: Test boundary cases including empty input, a single page, and a page number beyond the total to verify the helper returns correct slices.

text: Implement a minimal JavaScript HTTP server endpoint returning JSON.
expected_response: Use the built-in http module to create a server that responds with a JSON body and the correct Content-Type header.

text: Debug JavaScript event handler memory leak from lingering listeners.
expected_response: Store the handler reference and call removeEventListener during cleanup to prevent leaked closures from accumulating on every mount cycle.
